ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Graduate students will be assessed $362 per credit hour; undergrad students will be assessed $325 per credit hour. All students will be assessed a $50 per credit hour administration fee. These assessments are in addition to the campus range assessments if students also take an on-campus class. Consult the course syllabus for further details. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. Wireless Internet is not recommended. No class the week of Thanksgiving break (November 23rd). This course fulfills the requirement for CPSC 505 Research Methods.
